claim: Common workflows have dedicated tools; generic UNO exposes additional installed APIs. This is not exhaustive tested coverage.
verification: Real integration tests run in a LibreOffice container and GitHub Actions; native SDK registration, stdio, HTTP and browser panel tests are separate. Consult the Actions results for the tested commit.

areas.features: Creation, opening, metadata, save, export, close, undo
areas.verification: Roundtrip and overwrite integration tests

areas.features: Read, insert, replace, character and paragraph formatting
areas.verification: Writer roundtrip test

areas.features: Tables, bookmarks, fields, images, styles
areas.verification: Tables/bookmarks/fields/images/style editing and style creation covered by integration tests

areas.features: Groups, paths, connectors, layers, transformations, embedded objects
